from z3 import *

# 24 golfers, 5 weeks, 8 groups of 3
W = 5
G = 8
S = 3
P = G * S

solver = Solver()

# x[w][p] is the group of golfer p in week w
x = [[Int(f"x_{w}_{p}") for p in range(P)] for w in range(W)]

# Each golfer is in a group between 0 and G-1
for w in range(W):
    for p in range(P):
        solver.add(x[w][p] >= 0, x[w][p] < G)

# Each group has exactly S golfers
for w in range(W):
    for g in range(G):
        solver.add(Sum([If(x[w][p] == g, 1, 0) for p in range(P)]) == S)

# No pair of golfers in the same group more than once
for p1 in range(P):
    for p2 in range(p1 + 1, P):
        solver.add(Sum([If(x[w][p1] == x[w][p2], 1, 0) for w in range(W)]) <= 1)

# Symmetry breaking
# Week 0: golfer p is in group p // S
for p in range(P):
    solver.add(x[0][p] == p // S)

# Golfer 0 is always in group 0
for w in range(W):
    solver.add(x[w][0] == 0)

# Week 1: golfers 0, 3, 6 are in group 0
solver.add(x[1][0] == 0)
solver.add(x[1][3] == 0)
solver.add(x[1][6] == 0)

# Week 1: golfers 1, 4, 7 are in group 1
solver.add(x[1][1] == 1)
solver.add(x[1][4] == 1)
solver.add(x[1][7] == 1)

# Week 1: golfers 2, 5, 8 are in group 2
solver.add(x[1][2] == 2)
solver.add(x[1][5] == 2)
solver.add(x[1][8] == 2)

solver.set("timeout", 50000)
if solver.check() == sat:
    m = solver.model()
    res = []
    for w in range(W):
        for p in range(P):
            res.append(m[x[w][p]].as_long())
    print("SAT")
    print(res)
else:
    print("UNSAT or TIMEOUT")
